analysis:
Examined all supplied units, metadata and change excerpts against the canonical index and selected T-041 detail. No concrete security regression is established locally. ProviderLoop+StartupShutdown.swift:61,69-96 replaces indefinite slot teardown with a 15-second per-slot wait; unload tasks and resident slots can survive successful cleanup. Admission closure, App Attest worker stop, inflight drain/cancellation and coordinator shutdown still precede this step (24-60). Integration must verify that successful cleanup leads to actual process termination, including logout's credential-process-stop contract (A-008/T-053), and that MLX.Memory.clearCache at 63 is safe with outstanding unload/native retirement work (TB-007/T-028). The unload implementation and termination callers are outside this batch; their absence is not proof of a defect.
ProviderLoop+Trust.swift:50-54 adds configured model lists and a recovery report to existing local daemon diagnostics, not serving authorization. Connection diagnostic clearing remains unchanged at 150-172 (T-052/T-053/T-058). No prompt, key or cache payload is visibly added, but the recovery report implementation must be checked in integration for diagnostic contents. ProviderLoop+Testing.swift:520-527 adds internal scripted-load and wait seams without a visible external entry point. ProviderLoop.swift change excerpts at 781-792,954 add recovery state, saved-selection bookkeeping and initialization. Integration should trace selected-model recovery through shutdown cancellation, add-on hold/model-load fencing (A-018/T-059), committed switches, load admission and verified weight/cache binding (T-012/T-027/T-041). Those production interactions are not supplied here, so this pass does not establish their correctness. No visible change touches encryption, billing, privileged fan authority or Apple proof verification.
